name: mistral-prefix-enabled
purpose: convertMistralMessages marks a TRAILING ASSISTANT turn as a prefill (prompt-converters.js:709-713: getConfigValue('mistral.enablePrefix', false, 'boolean'), then lastMsg.prefix = true when the last message's role is assistant). The mistral arm forwards messages as-is, so the flag is visible on the wire. DISCRIMINATING BECAUSE: the last message must carry prefix: true while the earlier turns must not, and mistral-prefix-disabled is the same body with the flag false -- the two recordings differ by exactly that member, so neither can pass for the other.
stage1Boundary: Stage 1 validates the backend -> provider transformation only. Browser-side prompt assembly happens in the frontend before the request reaches the route and is NOT covered here; a green provider-wire capture is not evidence of preset-level equivalence.
